facts: The saved reply for delayed orders lists support hours of 9:00 to 17:00 (the ticket's body).
Since 2026-10-01, support answers from 8:00 to 20:00 (the ticket's body).
The ticket, its comments and the earlier answers contain no time zone for the hours.

questions.question: Should the reply list the hours, or link to the help page that lists them?

options.title: List the hours
options.explanation: A customer reads the hours in the reply.

options.title: Link to the help page
options.explanation: The reply stays correct when the hours change again.

questions.question:
Which time zone do the hours in **the reply** use?

- 9:00 to 17:00 today
- 8:00 to 20:00 after the change

options.title: The head office's time zone
options.explanation: The reply gives one set of hours for every customer.

options.title: The customer's time zone
options.explanation: A customer then reads the hours without a conversion.
